stops.name: Parco fluviale del Nera
stops.detail: The river park of the Black is a protected natural area of about 2,200 hectares of remarkable environmental value, located in the municipality of Terni, which includes the part of the Valnerina that goes from Ferentillo to the waterfall of the Marmore and comprising the rivers Velino and Nera. This area, of naturalistic and scenic impact, is rich in water and has a vegetation made of woodland, Mediterranean vegetation and typically fluvial vegetation, where flowers and ferns considered rare. Even the fauna is of great value and has many species of raptors such as the gheppio or the Biancone.
